## BuildOptions.failFast property

Throw an error summarizing hard structural findings after artifact generation and validation. [buildWithOutcome()](./core.buildwithoutcome.md) uses the same post-build checks as [build()](./core.build.md)<!-- -->. Findings from standalone validation and observed filesystem failures are included in the outcome. Default: false.

**Signature:**

```typescript
failFast?: boolean;
```
